source.note: Seat layout is read-only. `cars[].canvas.svg_url` points at the CDN-hosted vagon outline; the file is a graphical contour with no `<text>` seat numbers, so it is useful as an illustration but NOT as a vision-readable seat map — use `seats[].position` for any spatial reasoning.

pricing_note: Prices in `fares[]` are pre-cart totals (fare + its service fee) and run BELOW the final cart price: the checkout applies Tutu's own, larger service fee (observed +6–8%). The `search_rail` listing prices DO match the cart. Use this map to compare seats and fare types (refundable vs non-refundable deltas are correct); quote the bookable total from the search listing, or say the exact final price appears in the cart.
caveats: Seats listed here are *bookable*; sold/holding seats are omitted upstream and so are absent from this list.

Window/aisle flags are not provided and cannot be derived — the scheme marks neither windows nor the aisle. In lying-berth cars (плацкарт/купе/СВ/мягкий) every section has its own window, so «у окна» does not select a berth; in SEDENTARY window-vs-aisle is unknown here — say so instead of guessing from coordinates.
Power outlets / Wi-Fi are advertised at the wagon (`cars[].amenities`) level, never per seat.

meta.pagination_hint: Showed full seats for 2 of 8 car(s). Cars [2, 3, 4] returned `seats[:max_seats_per_car]` (partial — listed in `meta.cars_with_more_seats`, `seats_omitted_for_pagination=true`). Cars beyond `max_cars` ship as skeletons (`seats=[]`, `seats_omitted_for_pagination=true`). Pass `car_number=<id>` to load every seat of one car.
